Fixes the Light theme's table-header hover painting solid black instead of a normal light highlight.

## Fixed
- Hovering a download-table column header (e.g. "Name") with `JD_THEME=Light` painted the entire header cell solid black instead of a subtle hover highlight. Root cause: `FlatDarkLaf.properties` was registered as a custom FlatLaf defaults source, but no `FlatLightLaf.properties` ever existed, so the Light theme's `TableHeader.hoverBackground` fell back to an undefined value. Added `FlatLightLaf.properties` pinning the header hover/pressed colours explicitly. Reported in #16.
